text:
emma: Heads-up 1: QBR ask  Need a concise partner-health snapshot for NexusHW co-launch + a proposed MDF reweight toward marketplace credits. Can someone own the audit + cost/payback numbers? :mag:
diego: I can take the metrics piece. Will pull usage, leads, marketplace conversions. Target EOD Thu. Which partner cohort to include? All NexusHW-certified resellers + SIs?
priya: Include NexusHW-resellers + top 4 SI integrators (listed in our partner sheet). Sending link: https://redwood.internal/partners/nexushw (view-only).
thomas: Quick gating Q: Any contractual MDF minimums we must honor? Finance flagged two legacy commitments for pilots.
finance: FYI those pilots have committed credits: Pilot-Alpha (20k) and Pilot-Beta (15k). Remaining co-marketing pool has ~150k to reallocate. Can free up to 60k without renegotiation.
diego: Great, I
ll include pilot flags in the audit CSV. Will also compute cohort conversion for new marketplace listing vs reseller-driven deals.
emma: Target: have a recommendation for the Monday QBR: propose shifting 30% of co-marketing MDF into marketplace listing credits, with a short customer-facing rationale and risk mitigations. Need numerical impact + payback assumptions.
priya: Will draft scorecard changes if we shift credits: increase weight on marketplace activation (installs/listing leads) + pipeline velocity. Drafting now.
thomas: Ops constraint: if we boost marketplace credits, product needs a spend cap per partner to avoid runaway traffic spend. Can we propose a per-partner daily cap + throttles?
diego: Noted. Also capturing top technical blockers from SIs during onboarding: (1) network egress rules for on-prem installs, (2) model quantization docs lacking, (3) test data formats mismatch. Will surface in audit.
qa-bot: Reminder: QBR packet upload deadline 2024-04-02T17:00Z. Please place final doc in /drive/partnerships/qbrs/NexusHW/
priya: Draft rationale (one line): "Shift a portion of co-marketing MDF to marketplace listing credits to accelerate discoverability and shorten vendor-led deal cycles while preserving pilot runway." Will refine.
diego: Early numbers (rough): scenario_30pct -> credits_moved: 45_000, est_addl_marketplace_signups: 180, est_revenue_yr1: 66_000, payback: ~1.5x (assumes avg ARR 3.7k per signup). Full calc in sheet tab "nexushw-mdf-scenarios".
emma: Good. We also need a short contingency plan for the QBR: if marketplace conversion < 10% after 60 days, we revert to co-marketing pool or reallocate to SI enablement.
priya: Scorecard delta uploaded. Key changes: marketplace_activation +10pts, pipeline_velocity +5pts, partner_enablement -5pts (to balance).
thomas: Ops can implement per-partner daily cap of 2k credits and a global monthly throttle. Will draft the guardrail policy and automation rules.
diego: Audit checklist complete: partner_list ✅, enablement_assets_published? -> mixed (2/6 partners reported missing getting-started guide), top-3 technical issues (see above) ✅. Uploaded CSV and notes to the sheet.
finance: Thx. If recommendation moves forward we'll need a PO change note for internal accounting. Keep line items separate: marketplace_credits vs co-marketing_MDF.
emma: Action owners recap: @diego metrics + audit, @priya scorecard & one-liner rationale, @thomas ops guardrails, @finance PO note if approved. Please flag if any changes to timing.
priya: I
ll have scorecard + rationale by Thu morning.
diego: EOD Thu I
ll upload full audit and conversion cohorts.
thomas: Guardrail draft by Fri EOD.
qa-bot: File uploaded: /drive/partnerships/qbrs/NexusHW/packet-draft-v2.pdf (uploaded by emma)
emma: Thanks team. We'll do a 20-min sync Friday to align before we finalize the QBR recommendation. Calendar invite incoming. :calendar:
